incidents.name: ZS destory_pair_amount pair drain
incidents.notes: ZS exposes a permissionless destory_pair_amount() that deletes the ZS/BUSDT pair's ZS balance; the attacker called it and then sync()ed the pair to sell into the inflated price.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x12b3b6b1055b8ad1ae8f60a0b6c79a9825bcb4bc created 2023-09-26T10:35:05Z by 0x5d301735ea0e436856866b59e256842581710d2c, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x7ccf451d3c48c8bb747f42f29a0cde4209ff863e; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
